## Description

<!-- Provide a brief description of what this PR introduces, fixes, or enhances. -->

## Type of Change

- [ ] `feat`: A new feature
- [ ] `fix`: A bug fix
- [ ] `docs`: Documentation updates
- [ ] `style`: Formatting or styling changes without code logic changes
- [ ] `refactor`: Code restructuring without changing behavior
- [ ] `perf`: Performance improvement
- [ ] `test`: Adding or correcting tests
- [ ] `build`: Changes impacting build or external dependencies
- [ ] `ci`: CI/CD configuration updates
- [ ] `chore`: Maintenance or internal tooling updates

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] Code builds without errors (`pnpm build`)
- [ ] TypeScript type checks pass (`pnpm typecheck`)
- [ ] ESLint passes without errors or warnings (`pnpm lint`)
- [ ] Formatting complies with standards (`pnpm format:check`)
- [ ] Relevant tests have been added or updated
- [ ] Documentation has been updated where applicable
